Overview

Hanoi is a city in Hanoi with a population of 8,250,000. Vietnam’s thousand-year-old capital blends ancient pagodas and tree-lined boulevards with a thriving startup scene, offering a lower cost of living than Ho Chi Minh City. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
